def _install_generated_skills(framework_root: Path, target_root: Path, adapter_rel: str, version: str, content_hash: str) -> int:
    adapter_root = target_root / adapter_rel
    adapter_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    skills_src = framework_root / "process" / "skills"
    if not skills_src.is_dir():
        return 0

    count = 0
    for skill_dir in skills_src.iterdir():
        if not skill_dir.is_dir():
            continue
        skill_name = skill_dir.name
        dst_skill = adapter_root / skill_name
        marker_file = dst_skill / ".deltafuse-generated.yaml"

        if dst_skill.exists():
            if not marker_file.is_file():
                # Non-generated skill, preserve it
                continue
            shutil.rmtree(dst_skill)

        shutil.copytree(skill_dir, dst_skill)

        # Inject DO NOT EDIT banner into SKILL.md
        skill_md = dst_skill / "SKILL.md"
        if skill_md.is_file():
            content = skill_md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            banner = (
                f"---\n"
                f"# DO NOT EDIT: generated by DeltaFuse installer.\n"
                f"# deltafuse-version: {version}\n"
                f"# deltafuse-source: deltafuse://v{version}/skills/{skill_name}\n"
                f"# deltafuse-content-hash: sha256:{content_hash}\n"
            )
            content = re.sub(r"\A---\r?\n", banner, content)
            skill_md.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

        marker_content = (
            f"generated_by: deltafuse@{version}\n"
            f"source: deltafuse://v{version}/skills/{skill_name}\n"
            f"content_hash: sha256:{content_hash}\n"
        )
        marker_file.write_text(marker_content, encoding="utf-8")
        count += 1

    return count

name: Test on ${{ matrix.os }} with Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        python-version: ['3.10', '3.11', '3.12', '3.13', '3.14']

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install .[dev] || pip install jsonschema pyyaml pytest

      - name: Run Test Suite
        run: |
          python -m pytest -v

      - name: Run DeltaFuse Evals Benchmark
        run: |
          python -m deltafuse eval --scenario golden --min-schema-compliance 100.0 --min-gate-pass-rate 100.0
